column2: Concrete shrinkage data has the following characteristics:

column2: - It is a time series: measurements are recorded in time order

column2: - It has a trend: shrinkage typically increases then gradually stabilizes over time

column2: - It is context-dependent: today's shrinkage value depends on the previous day

column1: - Độ dài thay đổi: mỗi nhóm mẫu (GID) có số lượng phép đo khác nhau
column2: - Variable length: each sample group (GID) has a different number of measurements

column2: GRU is well suited because:

column2: b) The update gate helps "remember" the long-term shrinkage trend

column2: c) The reset gate helps "adapt" when there is a sudden change
